types.Roster B: order : List B; nodup : order.Nodup; complete : ∀ b, b ∈ order
types.Boundaries B P A D: B → Nat → Composition.Boundary P A D
types.ScheduleMismatch B: participant : B; expected : Nat; observed : Nat
types.AdmissionFailure B P A D: configuration | structural (participant : B) (failure : Parallel.LocalFailure) | schedule (mismatch : ScheduleMismatch B)
types.Attempt B P A D: participant : B; index : Nat; invocation : Invocation P A D; before : World P A D; outcome : Except Composition.Failure (StepResult P A D)
types.Machine B P A D: world : World P A D; locals : B → Interleaving.LocalState P A D; attempts : List (Attempt B P A D)
types.Result B P A D: refused (reason : AdmissionFailure B P A D) (world : World P A D) (schedule : Schedule B) | executed (schedule : Schedule B) (machine : Machine B P A D)
types.MonitorInput B P A D: participant : B; boundary : Boundary P A D; before : Machine B P A D; after : Machine B P A D; attempt : Option (Attempt B P A D)

shared_binders: DecidableEq B/P/A/D; Fintype P/A/D for actual executeStep/finite world observation. Roster supplies B enumeration; no Fintype B or noncomputable choice is required. Q arbitrary Type. Comparisons share the same type/instance universes.

helper_contracts.checkCountsFrom: explicit List B recursion; first count mismatch; empty returns ok; used only by checkSchedule
helper_contracts.Machine.setLocal: update selected local only by Boolean/equality decision on B
helper_contracts.Machine.skip: selected consumed increments; all other fields unchanged
helper_contracts.Machine.refuse: selected first failure/index/inv retained; appended actual error Attempt; unchanged world/history/index
helper_contracts.Machine.accept: selected consumed/index increment; actual event/world/receipt/output/Attempt appended
helper_contracts.recordReceipt: identity result.receipt in local event, with a unique explicit runtime binding for M10
helper_contracts.monitor_lookup: newly appended option at pre.attempts.length; no synthetic receipt or last-attempt replay
helper_contracts.monitor_fold: carry entire accumulated pair, not initial q, at each token

full_observation: machineEq compares Parallel.worldEq, every roster local consumed/nextIndex/failure/outputs plus event index/step/before/world/receipt/outputs, and all attempt participant/index/invocation/before/full-outcome fields in order. Prove true iff exact machine equality; result comparator additionally checks exact schedule and admission reason, unlike canonical historical comparators.
